name: Hamaoka Koaki
source:
Step daughter of her father's second marriage. She is a quiet girl, but her breasts are very large and they are still growing.

She's a little bit starved for affection. She likes her "new" brother very much.

She is also a member of the “Ladies' Alliance”. She has started a forbidden relationship for the sake of being part of the "Ladies' Alliance".
